title: Corn Salad

ingredients.item: fresh or frozen corn, rinsed and drained if frozen, and steamed, boiled, or grilled if fresh

steps: In a large bowl, toss onion, corn, tomatoes, feta, basil, oil and lime juice; season with salt and pepper.
notes: Total time on the source page is 15 min (prep 10 min; cook time listed as 0). Nutrition is 174 kcal, 4 g protein, 19 g carbs, and 9 g fat per serving. Delish says it can be made a day ahead and refrigerated; add the feta just before serving. Leftovers keep 2–3 days in an airtight container in the fridge. The ingredient list on the page is written as “1 limes, juiced”; this is recorded as 1 lime. Author: Lena Abraham.
